node.doctext:
its working now

Sorry, but I have to doubt that $in = system("snmpget ...") is really "working". [doc://system] returns the command's exit code as it would be returned by [man://wait;2|wait(2)]. The [man://snmpcmd|snmpcmd manpage] doesn't make any mention of exit codes, but the convention is that commands exit with 0 (zero) on success - so with the code shown in the question, $in and $out will probably be 0 most of the time, and some other number on failures.
